title: Miss Dona Kaminskaya

page_data.en:
D. 4486.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4486
Date 15 / 2 / 33

February 15, 3.

Sir,

Miss Dina Kaminskaya

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your
letter of February 10, 1933 and to inform you that there
is nothing in Police records detrimental to the character
of the above named whose full name is Dina Dimitrievna
Kaminskaya.

Enquiries show that she is 39 years of age, actress
by profession and arrived in Shanghai several years ago.
The lady in question was the wife of Mr. Troitsky from
whom she is divorced.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) F. W. Gerrard
Commissioner of Police.

Edwin S. Cunningham Esq.,
American Consul General,
Shanghai.

KwB

日期 1933年2月15日

1933年2月15日。

先生：

迪娜·卡明斯卡娅小姐（Miss Dina Kaminskaya）

谨此确认收到您1933年2月10日的来信，并告知您，上述人士（全名为迪娜·德米特里耶夫娜·卡明斯卡娅，Dina Dimitrievna Kaminskaya）在警方档案中并无任何损害其品行之记录。

经查，她现年39岁，职业为演员，于数年前抵达上海。该女士曾为特罗伊茨基先生（Mr. Troitsky）之妻，现已离异。

此致
敬礼

您的恭顺仆人，

（签名）F. W. 杰拉德（F. W. Gerrard）
警务处处长。

埃德温·S. 坎宁安先生（Edwin S. Cunningham Esq.），
美国驻上海总领事，
上海。

KwB

REPORT
Date February 14, 19 33
Subject (in full) Miss Dona Kaminskaya
Made by D.S.I. Ovsian nikoff Forwarded by Supt. Quayle
Sir,
With reference to the attached letter No. 133 G.V.A./W.C.L.
dated February 10th, 1933 from the American Consulate General, re
Miss Dona Kaminskaya, inquiries go to show that her full name is a
follows:- Miss Dina Dimitrievna Kaminskaya
She is 39 years of age, actress by profession and arrived in
Shanghai several years ago. It appears from inquiries that she
was wife of Mr. Troitsky, merchant mariner, with whom she is
divorced for some time. There is nothing known to the Police re-
garding her from criminal or political point of view.
I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
V. Ovsian nikoff
D.S.I.
Quayle
D.C. (Crime)

呈报人 副督察 Ovsian nikoff 转呈人 巡官 Quayle

先生：

关于附呈的美国驻上海总领事馆1933年2月10日第133 G.V.A./W.C.L.号来函，涉及多娜·卡明斯卡娅小姐一事，经查询，其全名如下：迪娜·德米特里耶夫娜·卡明斯卡娅小姐（Miss Dina Dimitrievna Kaminskaya）。

她现年39岁，职业为演员，于数年前抵达上海。据查，她曾是商船海员特罗伊茨基先生（Mr. Troitsky）的妻子，双方已离异一段时间。警方在刑事或政治方面均无关于她的不良记录。

此致
敬礼

V. Ovsian nikoff
副督察

Quayle
副警司（刑事）

DEPARTMENT OF STATE

AMERICAN CONSULAR SERVICE
American Consulate General
Shanghai, China, February 10, 1933.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4486
Date 13/2/33）

Subject: Miss Dona Kaminskaya.

Major F. W. Gerrard, C.I.E.,
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
18 Hankow Road,
Shanghai, China.

Sir:

I have the honor to request that you be kind
enough to furnish me with a copy of the criminal
record, if any, of Miss Dona Kaminskaya, of 436
Avenue Joffre, to whom an enlisted member of the
United States naval forces desired to be married.

I have the honor to be, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Edwin S. Cunningham

American Consul General.
